question: Should `optimizeImages` forwarding and `maxDurationSeconds` be accepted as durable Plugin SDK contracts while WhatsApp intentionally drops the former implicit all-local-roots behavior for injected readers?
rationale: The code path is technically bounded, but choosing public SDK surface and an upgrade-visible fail-closed boundary is a maintainer product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve canonical fail-closed media path
options.body: Accept the two SDK options and require callers that inject local readers to declare their authorized roots explicitly.

options.title: Keep the new controls private
options.body: Refactor the options behind an internal or WhatsApp-owned helper if maintainers do not want to expand the Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Preserve legacy reader behavior temporarily
options.body: Keep a named compatibility path only if a shipped integration contract requires it, with a documented removal or migration plan.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical fail-closed media path
recommendation.body: Accept the two SDK options and require callers that inject local readers to declare their authorized roots explicitly.
